policy.activation: No entry in this file activates a production asset or grants strict planner eligibility by itself.
policy.exactness: exact is phonetic identity; explicit_convention stores a canonical visible reading; variant_documented and playful_near remain separate; orthophony_locked is not automatically eligible.
policy.naming: anticipatedNamingRisk is editorial anticipation only. spontaneousNamingRisk remains unknown until real human naming evidence exists.
policy.orthophony: humanNamingEvidence and clinicalEvidence are never inferred from editorial curation.
policy.artDirection: visualBrief is a future illustration brief only. No illustration is produced by this wave.
policy.multiplicity: Several serious representations may share the same IPA; no canonical winner is selected here.

entries.label: chat

entries.label: rat

entries.label: pas

entries.label: bas
